description: Source code for a tabwriter package implementing a text formatting filter that aligns tab-delimited columns, supporting features like HTML filtering, escape sequences, and column width management.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: A struct implementing a configurable text filter that aligns tab-separated columns with support for various formatting options.

classes.name: cell
classes.description: A struct representing a segment of text terminated by tabs or line breaks, with size, width, and termination type.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes a Writer with configuration parameters such as output, minwidth, tabwidth, padding, padchar, and flags.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered data, formatting the current buffer into aligned columns.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes input bytes to the Writer, processing tabs, line breaks, escape sequences, and HTML tags for formatting.

methods.name: RememberedWidths
methods.description: Returns a copy of the maximum widths recorded for each column.

methods.name: SetRememberedWidths
methods.description: Sets the maximum widths for columns based on provided widths.
